'''Katiz Xemir''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who hired himself out against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] targets after the Empire [[Death/Legends|killed]] his family. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], while he was on [[StarForge Station]], Xemir applied for a berth on the ''[[Far Orbit]]'', an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that had docked there.

==Biography==
Katiz Xemir was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] settler on a [[Katiz Xemir's homeworld|remote colony world]]. When he refused to leave and go offworld to make way for a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] his family. Left without a home and his closest of kin, Xemir drifted around, becoming a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who only took jobs that targeted Imperials.<ref name="Orbit" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> he was on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[StarForge Station]], located in the [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]], when the ''[[Far Orbit]]'' docked there. An [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] whose crew had recently [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutinied]] from under Imperial control and become [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the ''Far Orbit''{{'s}} call for new crew members caused Xemir to apply for a position on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="Orbit" />

==Personality and traits==
After the death of his family at Imperial hands, Xemir took up a grudge, hiring himself out as a mercenary to people who targeted the Empire. The man stood two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and was lean, quiet, and self-absorbed.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Equipment==
Xemir owned a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], two smaller [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistols]], a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], and a [[Knife/Legends|combat knife]]. He, at some point in [[Time/Legends|time]], wore a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] and a [[Clothing/Legends|cloak]], and on at least one occasion chewed a toothpick.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Katiz Xemir first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure idea from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the privateering vessel ''Far Orbit''. The man was provided as a sample character of the individuals who could apply for berths on the ship. It is up to player discretion as to who gets a job on the ship. The scenario mentions that Xemir would probably end up serving in the Alliance sometime after his encounter with the ''Far Orbit''.<ref name="Orbit" />
